_comment: Input of code/tools/blurx_catalog/catalog.py build: the discs the BlurX asset catalog covers.
root: the disc as supplied on this machine (never modified); the game can be pointed elsewhere
with --disc=<id>=<dir>. cache: the folder holding the disc's paks, relative to root.
generation: A = Blur 1 layout (retail formats), B = Kanzen layout (AGENTS.md 'Disc generations').
damaged: payloads and loose files known to be damaged; loose files with zero-filled 32 KB blocks
are marked suspect. mounts: archive -> [mount point, path inside the pak], the Xenon mount set of
the Blur 1 source (GameSystems.cpp CreateFsLayers, BootLayer.cpp, AmaxWorldLayer.cpp) plus
models.pak as the PC/PS3 branches mount it; order = the order the engine mounts them.
layers: game folders the Xenon engine overlays at / as media layer 1 (GameHelpers.cpp
CreateGameFs, 'layer1'); their loose files are catalogued at the same virtual paths. Their
cache folder is not read (retail's layer1/cache/root_streaming.pak is byte-identical to cache/'s).
